history.summary: Plan completed and committed (ff400ae): task shape pre-settled, six phases — OpenBao AppRole (ansible), then ArgoCDTools' repo/gate/credential layer, the presync flow, the PV reattach, the image and CI, then homelab-shared 0.2.0 for the fourth Job argument. One attachment, credential-map.md, carries the credential inventory the executors cannot derive; verification.json has 18 outcome-level criteria covering R1-R3. Two things surfaced during verification and are recorded in the plan rather than left implicit: the hook's age keypair must be the same value iac uses today or phases.md B.4's state surgery yields undecryptable state, and no single GitHub token can express the requirement's 'state repo read-write, deploy repos read-only' split, so the over-grant is named and recommended rather than assumed away.

ACs are complete and citations hold, but the ruled fourth Job argument contradicts design.md's three-argument contract with no path to slice 009 (operator call), P1's consumer enumeration omits the two approle.yml loops its cited staging loop reads back from, and the kubernetes Terraform provider is left with no stated credential path that the ruled proof bar could detect.

Fix pass applied and committed (781568c). Every ruling now reaches the phases: P3 synthesises the kubeconfig from the pod's ServiceAccount and P4's reattach shares it (F3), credential-map.md re-derives the outside-namespace leaves from providers.tf + setup-env.sh under the ruled superset rule (F4), and new P7 (Target ../AnsibleSpecs) writes the four-argument contract into the argo-cd/ model so slice 009 plans against it (F1). Blocking F2 fixed by re-reading approle.yml end to end — it names its consumers in ten loops, not five, and the two the old list omitted are the role_id/secret_id reads the staging tasks read back from; the bullet now states the outcome and the mid-play failure instead of a checklist. Advisories F5/F6 taken: V10 gains the deploy-owed escape, P6 names the render gate's hard-coded tag literal and its substring match. verification.json is 20 criteria (V19 kubernetes-provider identity, V20 the model's contract); plan parses clean under run_loop.py --dry-run with all seven Targets resolving.
